title: Sporefall
summary: Start: enter Sporefall. The log opens the job and the helm marks Glass Choir Cutter 1. Do: come within 320 meters of that cutter. Blight weather eats a harvest drone that parks in it. The wardens patrol and will burn a bad hold. Finish: after the cutter is met, come inside Blight Moon's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
